scope: One independent model proofreading execution plus primary-agent reading of each complete output; developer-created samples, no pre-change comparison or literary superiority claim
reading_result: Corrections address subject omission, 的/地, quoted sentence terminator, medial speech tag punctuation and explicitly declarative sentence ending. Ambiguous pronoun marked; dialogue ellipsis, nested and multiparagraph quotations, punctuation combinations, code/URL/decimal/chat symbols and embedded quotation retained.
